```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
```

Load packages and data

```{r libraries}
library(DESeq2)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(limma)
```

Read experiment design and count matrix

```{r, read data}
design_file <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "Trait_A17_sunn.csv")
count_file  <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "ShootCounts_A17_sunn.csv")

experiment_design <- read.csv(design_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
counts_df         <- read.csv(count_file,  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Count matrix: first column = GeneID, rest = sample counts
gene_ids   <- counts_df[, 1]
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1])
rownames(counts_mat) <- gene_ids

# Design: use RNA.seq.id as sample ID; keep only samples present in both
rownames(experiment_design) <- experiment_design$RNA.seq.id
samples_in_both <- intersect(colnames(counts_mat), experiment_design$RNA.seq.id)

# Remove outlier sample
outlier_id <- "MTNC159"
n_before <- length(samples_in_both)
samples_in_both <- setdiff(samples_in_both, outlier_id)
if (length(samples_in_both) < n_before) cat("Removed outlier sample:", outlier_id, "\n")

counts_mat <- counts_mat[, samples_in_both, drop = FALSE]
experiment_design <- experiment_design[samples_in_both, ]

# Sanity check
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_mat) == experiment_design$RNA.seq.id))
cat("Samples:", ncol(counts_mat), "\n")
cat("Genes: ", nrow(counts_mat), "\n")
```

Preprocess CleanUp and Parameter Setting

```{r define-factors}
experiment_design$Line     <- factor(experiment_design$Line, levels = c("A17", "sunn"))
experiment_design$Nitrogen <- as.numeric(as.character(experiment_design$Nitrogen))
experiment_design$CO2      <- factor(experiment_design$CO2, levels = c("AC", "EC"))
experiment_design$Replicate <- factor(experiment_design$Replicate)
```

#DESeq2 analysis

```{r deseq-run}
coldata <- experiment_design[colnames(counts_mat), ]

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_mat),
  colData   = coldata,
  design    = ~ Replicate + Nitrogen + CO2 + Line + CO2:Nitrogen + Line:Nitrogen + Line:CO2
)

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)

out_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "DEG_analysis")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
saveRDS(dds, file.path(out_dir, "dds_shoot.rds"))
```

```{r all-contrasts}
curated_gene_names <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.gene_names.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character())
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = locus_tag,
    curated_gene_name = acronym,
    curated_gene_product = geneProduct
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

genome_annotation <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("MT_genome", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.summary.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character())
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = LOCUS_TAG,
    summary_gene_name = GN,
    summary_gene_product = PRODUCT
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

gene_names <- dplyr::full_join(
  genome_annotation,
  curated_gene_names,
  by = "gene"
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    gene_name = dplyr::coalesce(
      dplyr::na_if(curated_gene_name, ""),
      dplyr::na_if(summary_gene_name, ""),
      ""
    ),
    gene_product = dplyr::coalesce(
      dplyr::na_if(summary_gene_product, ""),
      dplyr::na_if(curated_gene_product, ""),
      ""
    )
  )

# All coefficients from design (exclude Intercept and Replicate)
coefs <- resultsNames(dds)
coefs <- coefs[coefs != "Intercept" & !grepl("^Replicate", coefs)]

all_deg_tables <- list()

for (coef in coefs) {
  res <- results(dds, name = coef)

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) %>%
    left_join(gene_names, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, ""),
      gene_product = coalesce(gene_product, ""),
      coef = coef
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      coef, gene, gene_name, gene_product, log2FoldChange, padj
    ) %>%
    arrange(padj)

  all_deg_tables[[coef]] <- res_df
}

# Write one combined DEG table
all_deg_combined <- bind_rows(all_deg_tables)
readr::write_csv(
  all_deg_combined,
  file.path(out_dir, "DEG_all_coefficients_combined.csv")
)
```

## 2.4 DEG counts by model term

Bar chart showing number of significant DEGs attributed to each term in the DESeq2 model.

```{r deg-counts-by-term, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
deg_by_term <- tibble::tibble(
  coefficient = names(all_deg_tables),
  n_DEGs = vapply(all_deg_tables, nrow, integer(1))
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TermType = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("\\.", coefficient) ~ "Interaction",
      grepl("^Line", coefficient) ~ "Line",
      grepl("^CO2", coefficient) ~ "CO2",
      coefficient == "Nitrogen" ~ "Nitrogen",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Term = dplyr::case_when(
      TermType == "Line" ~ "sunn vs A17",
      TermType == "CO2" ~ "CO2",
      TermType == "Nitrogen" ~ "Nitrogen",
      TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(
        coefficient,
        c(
          "CO2_EC_vs_AC|CO2EC" = "CO2",
          "Line_sunn_vs_A17|Linesunn" = "Line",
          "\\." = " × "
        )
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(TermType != "Other") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TermType = factor(
      TermType,
      levels = c("Line", "CO2", "Nitrogen", "Interaction")
    ),
    Term = forcats::fct_reorder(Term, n_DEGs, .desc = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(deg_by_term, aes(x = Term, y = n_DEGs, fill = TermType)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_DEGs), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Line = "chocolate2", CO2 = "cadetblue4", Nitrogen = "darkolivegreen", Interaction = "coral4"),
    name = "Term type"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    title = "Shoot DEGs"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## 2.5 DEG overlap among Nitrogen, CO2, and Line

```{r deg-venn-n-c-l, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
# Select the three main-effect DEG sets (excluding interaction terms)
find_main_effect <- function(candidates, label) {
  matched <- intersect(candidates, names(all_deg_tables))
  if (length(matched) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Expected one ", label, " coefficient; found: ",
      ifelse(length(matched) == 0L, "none", paste(matched, collapse = ", "))
    )
  }
  matched
}

n_coef <- find_main_effect(c("Nitrogen"), "Nitrogen")
c_coef <- find_main_effect(c("CO2_EC_vs_AC", "CO2EC"), "CO2")
l_coef <- find_main_effect(c("Line_sunn_vs_A17", "Linesunn"), "Line")

main_effect_sets <- setNames(
  lapply(c(n_coef, c_coef, l_coef), \(x) unique(na.omit(all_deg_tables[[x]]$gene))),
  c("Nitrogen", "CO2", "Line")
)
N <- main_effect_sets$Nitrogen
C <- main_effect_sets$CO2
L <- main_effect_sets$Line

venn_counts <- c(
  length(setdiff(N, union(C, L))),
  length(setdiff(C, union(N, L))),
  length(setdiff(L, union(N, C))),
  length(setdiff(intersect(N, C), L)),
  length(setdiff(intersect(N, L), C)),
  length(setdiff(intersect(C, L), N)),
  length(Reduce(intersect, main_effect_sets))
)

old_par <- par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(-1.8, 1.8), ylim = c(-1.75, 1.6), asp = 1)
venn_colors <- c("#66A61E", "#1F78B4", "#E66101")
symbols(
  c(-0.55, 0.55, 0), c(0.25, 0.25, -0.5),
  circles = rep(1, 3), inches = FALSE, add = TRUE,
  bg = grDevices::adjustcolor(venn_colors, alpha.f = 0.38),
  fg = venn_colors, lwd = 2
)
text(
  c(-0.95, 0.95, 0, 0, -0.5, 0.5, 0),
  c(0.55, 0.55, -1.05, 0.72, -0.35, -0.35, 0.02),
  venn_counts, cex = c(rep(1.2, 6), 1.25), font = c(rep(1, 6), 2)
)
text(
  c(-1.15, 1.15, 0), c(1.3, 1.3, -1.58),
  paste0(names(main_effect_sets), "\n(n = ", lengths(main_effect_sets), ")"),
  font = 2
)
title("Shoot DEGs")
box()
par(old_par)

# Save genes shared by at least two Venn sets
all_genes <- Reduce(union, main_effect_sets)
intersection_summary <- tibble(
  gene = all_genes,
  In_Nitrogen = all_genes %in% N,
  In_CO2 = all_genes %in% C,
  In_Line = all_genes %in% L
) %>%
  filter(In_Nitrogen + In_CO2 + In_Line >= 2L) %>%
  mutate(
    Intersection = case_when(
      In_Nitrogen & In_CO2 & In_Line ~ "Nitrogen & CO2 & Line",
      In_Nitrogen & In_CO2 ~ "Nitrogen & CO2",
      In_Nitrogen & In_Line ~ "Nitrogen & Line",
      TRUE ~ "CO2 & Line"
    ),
    .before = 1
  )

effect_statistics <- bind_rows(
  all_deg_tables[[n_coef]] %>%
    transmute(gene, Effect = "Nitrogen", log2FoldChange, padj),
  all_deg_tables[[c_coef]] %>%
    transmute(gene, Effect = "CO2", log2FoldChange, padj),
  all_deg_tables[[l_coef]] %>%
    transmute(gene, Effect = "Line", log2FoldChange, padj)
) %>%
  filter(gene %in% intersection_summary$gene) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Effect,
    values_from = c(log2FoldChange, padj),
    names_glue = "{Effect}_{.value}"
  )

intersection_summary <- intersection_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    gene_names,
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_name = dplyr::coalesce(gene_name, ""),
    gene_product = dplyr::coalesce(gene_product, "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(effect_statistics, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Intersection, gene)

readr::write_csv(
  intersection_summary,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "DEG_Nitrogen_CO2_Line_intersections_summary.csv"
  )
)
```

### Direction-aware UpSet plot

The Venn diagram above combines all significant DEGs regardless of direction.
This plot separates up- and downregulated genes for each effect. `Not_DEG`
means that the gene does not meet the adjusted-P-value threshold for that main
effect.

```{r deg-upset-n-c-l, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
effect_coefs <- c(Nitrogen = n_coef, CO2 = c_coef, Line = l_coef)
directional_sets <- list()

for (effect in names(effect_coefs)) {
  tbl <- all_deg_tables[[effect_coefs[[effect]]]]
  valid <- !is.na(tbl$gene) & !is.na(tbl$log2FoldChange)
  directional_sets[[paste0(effect, "_up")]] <-
    unique(tbl$gene[valid & tbl$log2FoldChange > 0])
  directional_sets[[paste0(effect, "_down")]] <-
    unique(tbl$gene[valid & tbl$log2FoldChange < 0])
}

directional_set_names <- names(directional_sets)
upset_genes <- Reduce(union, directional_sets)
if (length(upset_genes) == 0L) {
  stop("No significant main-effect DEGs are available for the UpSet plot.")
}

upset_membership <- tibble::tibble(gene = upset_genes)
for (set_name in directional_set_names) {
  upset_membership[[set_name]] <-
    upset_membership$gene %in% directional_sets[[set_name]]
}

direction_label <- function(up, down) {
  ifelse(up, "Up", ifelse(down, "Down", "Not_DEG"))
}

upset_membership <- upset_membership %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Nitrogen_direction = direction_label(Nitrogen_up, Nitrogen_down),
    CO2_direction = direction_label(CO2_up, CO2_down),
    Line_direction = direction_label(Line_up, Line_down),
    Direction_pattern = paste0(
      "Nitrogen=", Nitrogen_direction,
      "; CO2=", CO2_direction,
      "; Line=", Line_direction
    )
  )

# Count exact observed membership patterns and order them by abundance.
upset_pattern_plot_data <- upset_membership %>%
  dplyr::count(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(directional_set_names)),
    name = "n_genes",
    sort = TRUE
  )
upset_pattern_matrix <- as.matrix(
  upset_pattern_plot_data[directional_set_names]
)
set_sizes <- colSums(upset_membership[directional_set_names])

# Draw a dependency-free UpSet layout. Set sizes are shown beside row labels.
old_mfrow <- par("mfrow")
old_mar <- par("mar")
layout(matrix(c(1, 2), ncol = 1), heights = c(2.2, 1.25))

par(mar = c(0.5, 11, 3.5, 1))
bar_midpoints <- barplot(
  upset_pattern_plot_data$n_genes,
  names.arg = rep("", nrow(upset_pattern_plot_data)),
  axes = FALSE,
  col = "#4D4D4D",
  border = NA,
  ylab = "Intersection size"
)
axis(2, las = 1)
text(
  bar_midpoints,
  upset_pattern_plot_data$n_genes,
  labels = upset_pattern_plot_data$n_genes,
  pos = 3,
  xpd = NA,
  cex = 0.8
)
title(main = "Shoot DEG intersections")
mtext(
  "Main-effect DEGs, adjusted P < 0.05",
  side = 3,
  line = 0.25,
  cex = 0.85
)

par(mar = c(2, 11, 0.5, 1))
set_y <- rev(seq_along(directional_set_names))
plot(
  NA,
  xlim = range(bar_midpoints) + c(-0.6, 0.6),
  ylim = range(set_y) + c(-0.5, 0.5),
  xaxs = "i",
  yaxs = "i",
  axes = FALSE,
  xlab = "",
  ylab = ""
)
axis(
  2,
  at = set_y,
  labels = paste0(
    gsub("_", " ", directional_set_names, fixed = TRUE),
    " (n = ", set_sizes, ")"
  ),
  las = 1,
  tick = FALSE
)
abline(h = set_y, col = "#EEEEEE", lwd = 1)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(upset_pattern_matrix))) {
  points(
    rep(bar_midpoints[i], length(set_y)),
    set_y,
    pch = 16,
    col = "#D9D9D9",
    cex = 1.05
  )
  active_rows <- which(upset_pattern_matrix[i, ])
  if (length(active_rows) > 1L) {
    segments(
      bar_midpoints[i], min(set_y[active_rows]),
      bar_midpoints[i], max(set_y[active_rows]),
      col = "#222222",
      lwd = 2
    )
  }
  points(
    rep(bar_midpoints[i], length(active_rows)),
    set_y[active_rows],
    pch = 16,
    col = "#222222",
    cex = 1.1
  )
}
box()

layout(matrix(1))
par(mfrow = old_mfrow, mar = old_mar)

upset_effect_statistics <- lapply(names(effect_coefs), function(effect) {
  DESeq2::results(dds, name = effect_coefs[[effect]]) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene,
      Effect = .env$effect,
      log2FoldChange,
      padj
    )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% upset_genes) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Effect,
    values_from = c(log2FoldChange, padj),
    names_glue = "{Effect}_{.value}"
  )

upset_summary <- upset_membership %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_names, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_name = dplyr::coalesce(gene_name, ""),
    gene_product = dplyr::coalesce(gene_product, "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(upset_effect_statistics, by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    Direction_pattern,
    Nitrogen_direction, CO2_direction, Line_direction,
    .after = gene
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Direction_pattern, gene)

readr::write_csv(
  upset_summary,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "DEG_Nitrogen_CO2_Line_direction_patterns.csv"
  )
)
```

## 2.6 topGO enrichment for Line DEGs

Biological-process enrichment is run separately for upregulated and
downregulated Line DEGs.

```{r topgo-model-terms}
if (!requireNamespace("topGO", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Package 'topGO' is required. Install it with ",
    "BiocManager::install('topGO')."
  )
}
if (!requireNamespace("GO.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Package 'GO.db' is required. Install it with ",
    "BiocManager::install('GO.db')."
  )
}

# topGO looks up ontology term objects such as GOBPTerm on the search path.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(topGO)
  library(GO.db)
})

go_pairs_file <- here(
  "MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv"
)
if (!file.exists(go_pairs_file)) {
  stop("GO annotation file not found: ", go_pairs_file)
}

go_pairs <- readr::read_tsv(
  go_pairs_file,
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene = LOCUS_TAG, go = GO) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(gene), gene != "",
    !is.na(go), go != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, go)

GO2genes <- split(go_pairs$gene, go_pairs$go)
go_universe <- intersect(rownames(dds), unique(go_pairs$gene))

topgo_coefs <- l_coef

topgo_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "topGO_model_terms")
dir.create(topgo_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

parse_topgo_p <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(
    grepl("^<", x),
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^<", "", x))),
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  )
}

empty_topgo_result <- function(coef, direction, query_n) {
  tibble::tibble(
    coefficient = coef,
    direction = direction,
    QueryGeneN = query_n,
    GO.ID = character(),
    Term = character(),
    Annotated = integer(),
    Significant = integer(),
    Expected = numeric(),
    Fisher = character(),
    Fisher_pvalue = numeric(),
    padj = numeric(),
    FoldEnrichment = numeric()
  )
}

run_model_term_topgo <- function(coef, direction) {
  deg_table <- all_deg_tables[[coef]]
  if (is.null(deg_table)) {
    stop("No DEG table found for coefficient: ", coef)
  }

  query_genes <- deg_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      if (direction == "up") log2FoldChange > 0 else log2FoldChange < 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique() %>%
    intersect(go_universe)

  safe_coef <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", coef)
  output_prefix <- paste0(safe_coef, "_", direction, "_topGO_BP")

  if (length(query_genes) == 0L) {
    result_table <- empty_topgo_result(coef, direction, 0L)
    readr::write_csv(
      result_table,
      file.path(topgo_dir, paste0(output_prefix, ".csv"))
    )
    message(coef, " ", direction, ": no GO-annotated DEGs; skipped.")
    return(result_table)
  }

  gene_list <- stats::setNames(
    as.integer(go_universe %in% query_genes),
    go_universe
  )

  GOdata <- methods::new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = "BP",
    allGenes = gene_list,
    geneSel = function(x) x == 1L,
    annot = topGO::annFUN.GO2genes,
    GO2genes = GO2genes,
    nodeSize = 5
  )

  fisher_result <- topGO::runTest(
    GOdata,
    algorithm = "weight01",
    statistic = "fisher"
  )

  n_terms <- length(topGO::score(fisher_result))
  result_table <- topGO::GenTable(
    GOdata,
    Fisher = fisher_result,
    orderBy = "Fisher",
    ranksOf = "Fisher",
    topNodes = n_terms,
    numChar = 200
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      coefficient = coef,
      direction = direction,
      QueryGeneN = length(query_genes),
      Fisher_pvalue = parse_topgo_p(Fisher),
      padj = stats::p.adjust(Fisher_pvalue, method = "BH"),
      Significant_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Significant)),
      Expected_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Expected)),
      FoldEnrichment = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(Expected_num) & Expected_num > 0,
        Significant_num / Expected_num,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      coefficient, direction, QueryGeneN, GO.ID, Term,
      Annotated, Significant, Expected, Fisher,
      Fisher_pvalue, padj, FoldEnrichment
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Fisher_pvalue)

  significant_table <- result_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

  readr::write_csv(
    result_table,
    file.path(topgo_dir, paste0(output_prefix, ".csv"))
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    significant_table,
    file.path(topgo_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_significant.csv"))
  )

  message(
    coef, " ", direction, ": ", length(query_genes),
    " GO-annotated DEGs; ", nrow(significant_table),
    " BP terms with padj < 0.05."
  )
  result_table
}

model_term_topgo_results <- list()
for (coef in topgo_coefs) {
  model_term_topgo_results[[coef]] <- list(
    up = run_model_term_topgo(coef, "up"),
    down = run_model_term_topgo(coef, "down")
  )
}

all_model_term_topgo <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  model_term_topgo_results,
  function(x) dplyr::bind_rows(x$up, x$down)
))

readr::write_csv(
  all_model_term_topgo,
  file.path(topgo_dir, "Line_up_down_topGO_BP.csv")
)
saveRDS(
  model_term_topgo_results,
  file.path(topgo_dir, "Line_up_down_topGO_BP_results.rds")
)
```

## 2.7 Individual lollipop plots of selected significant GO terms

```{r topgo-lollipop-plots, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
if (!requireNamespace("ggtext", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'ggtext' is required. Install it with install.packages('ggtext').")
}

line_coef <- l_coef

bubble_specs <- list(
  list(coef = line_coef, direction = "up", label = "Line contrast: up"),
  list(coef = line_coef, direction = "down", label = "Line contrast: down")
)

bp_class_ids <- list(
  "Nitrogen assimilation" = c("GO:0042128", "GO:0019676", "GO:0006537"),
  "Nitrogen-starvation response" = "GO:0006995",
  "Defense response" = "GO:0006952",
  "Autophagy" = "GO:0006914",
  "Ubiquitination" = "GO:0016567",
  "Protein phosphorylation" = "GO:0006468",
  "Signal transduction" = "GO:0007165",
  "Translation" = "GO:0006412",
  "rRNA processing" = "GO:0006364",
  "Ribosome biogenesis" = "GO:0042254",
  "RNA modification" = "GO:0009451",
  "Protein folding" = "GO:0006457",
  "Protein targeting" = "GO:0006605",
  "DNA replication" = "GO:0006260",
  "DNA repair" = "GO:0006281"
)

bp_class_colors <- c(
  "Nitrogen assimilation" = "#2CA25F",
  "Nitrogen-starvation response" = "#99D8C9",
  "Defense response" = "#D73027",
  "Autophagy" = "#FC8D59",
  "Ubiquitination" = "#E78AC3",
  "Protein phosphorylation" = "#8E44AD",
  "Signal transduction" = "#756BB1",
  "Translation" = "#1F78B4",
  "rRNA processing" = "#6BAED6",
  "Ribosome biogenesis" = "#9ECAE1",
  "RNA modification" = "#00A6A6",
  "Protein folding" = "#E6AB02",
  "Protein targeting" = "#A6761D",
  "DNA replication" = "#F768A1",
  "DNA repair" = "#AE017E",
  "Other BP" = "#BDBDBD"
)

bp_ancestor_map <- as.list(GO.db::GOBPANCESTOR)

classify_bp_term <- function(go_id) {
  ancestors <- unique(c(go_id, bp_ancestor_map[[go_id]]))
  matched_classes <- names(bp_class_ids)[vapply(
    bp_class_ids,
    function(class_ids) any(class_ids %in% ancestors),
    logical(1)
  )]
  if (length(matched_classes) == 0L) {
    "Other BP"
  } else {
    matched_classes[1]
  }
}

plot_topgo_lollipop <- function(coef, direction, label) {
  eligible_terms <- all_model_term_topgo %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$coefficient == .env$coef,
      .data$direction == .env$direction,
      !is.na(Fisher_pvalue),
      !is.na(padj),
      padj < 0.05,
      !is.na(FoldEnrichment),
      FoldEnrichment > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, Fisher_pvalue)

  plot_data <- eligible_terms %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Significant_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Significant)),
      minus_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      BroadClass = factor(
        vapply(GO.ID, classify_bp_term, character(1)),
        levels = c(names(bp_class_ids), "Other BP")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(BroadClass, padj, Fisher_pvalue) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      GO.ID = factor(GO.ID, levels = rev(unique(GO.ID)))
    )

  axis_key <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      go_id = as.character(GO.ID),
      axis_label = paste0(
        "<b><span style='color:",
        bp_class_colors[as.character(BroadClass)],
        "'>", go_id, "</span></b>"
      )
    )
  axis_labels <- stats::setNames(axis_key$axis_label, axis_key$go_id)

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    message(label, ": no GO terms available for plotting.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = FoldEnrichment,
      y = GO.ID,
      size = Significant_num,
      color = minus_log10_padj
    )
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(x = 0, xend = FoldEnrichment, y = GO.ID, yend = GO.ID),
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.6,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(x = Inf, y = GO.ID, fill = BroadClass),
      shape = 22,
      alpha = 0,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = axis_labels) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#FDE725", "#90D743", "#35B779", "#31688E", "#440154"),
      name = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p")),
      guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "vertical")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = bp_class_colors,
      name = "GO functional class"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "DEGs in GO term", range = c(2, 9)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(label, " — topGO BP"),
      x = "Fold enrichment",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 9),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(
        direction = "vertical",
        position = "right"
      ),
      fill = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, shape = 22, size = 4),
        position = "right",
        ncol = 1
      ),
      size = guide_legend(position = "bottom")
    )

  safe_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(label))
  readr::write_csv(
    plot_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(GO.ID = as.character(GO.ID)) %>%
      dplyr::select(GO.ID, Term, BroadClass, padj, FoldEnrichment, Significant),
    file.path(topgo_dir, paste0(safe_label, "_topGO_BP_plot_key.csv"))
  )
  print(p)
  p
}

selected_topgo_lollipop_plots <- lapply(
  bubble_specs,
  function(x) plot_topgo_lollipop(x$coef, x$direction, x$label)
)
```
